standard_prerequisites: Rational equivalence by locally finite sums of divisors of rational functions on integral closed subspaces of one dimension higher, and restriction of cycles to an open subspace
The reduced closed subspace structure on the complement of an open subspace and the closed immersion carrying it into the ambient space

The exactness statement identifying cycles on the ambient space whose restriction to the open vanishes with the pushforwards of cycles on the closed complement, and local finiteness of a family of irreducible components in a Noetherian space
core_obligations: Assume the two cycles become rationally equivalent after restriction to the open, and write that equivalence as a locally finite sum of divisors of rational functions on integral closed subspaces of the open

Replace each of those subspaces by the integral closed subspace of the ambient space with the same generic point, and verify that the resulting family is again locally finite by testing against quasi-compact opens, where the finiteness of the intersections transfers

Observe that the rational function fields agree, so the difference between the original cycles and the sum of the pushed forward divisors is a cycle on the ambient space whose restriction to the open vanishes
Apply the exactness statement for the closed complement to express that cycle as the pushforward of a cycle on the complement, which is the required conclusion
proof_roadmap: Lift the rational equivalence from the open to the ambient space through the generic points of the components
Check local finiteness of the lifted family against quasi-compact opens
Apply the exactness statement for the closed complement
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the right exactness of the localisation sequence of Chow groups at source lines 1950-1968, label lemma-restrict-to-open, whose proof occupies source lines 1970-1988. The proof does not merely quote exactness: it lifts a rational equivalence from the open subspace to the ambient space by replacing each component on the open by the integral closed subspace with the same generic point, and it has to verify that the lifted family is still locally finite, which is done by testing against quasi-compact opens and using that the intersections transfer. Since the rational function fields are unchanged, the difference of the original cycles and the sum of the pushed forward divisors restricts to zero on the open, and the exactness statement for the closed complement then produces the required cycle. The counted statement records neither the lifting nor the local finiteness check.
